protocol.fault_stage: business committed; before first atomic export replacement
protocol.recovery: same UUID; restart existing Worker Job or rerun direct command
protocol.timing: from submit/direct spawn through success and process shutdown; setup and terminal re-export excluded
protocol.policy: production defaults: 2 retries, 5/60 second backoff, 300 second timeout
protocol.gate: production GitHubHTTP, per-instance API flock, default budgets; fixed local transport
protocol.order: alternate TaskForge/direct ordering by repetition; compare semantics before timings
